entries.english: Add verified self-update support that preserves the Homebrew, go install, or Release-archive installation channel.
entries.zh_cn: 新增经校验的自更新能力，并保留 Homebrew、go install 或 Release 压缩包的安装渠道。

entries.english: Preserve LF source bytes on Windows release runners and pass the validated version into production builds.
entries.zh_cn: 修复 Windows 发布 runner 的 LF 源码字节保留问题，并将已校验版本传递给生产构建。

entries.english: Align the repository layout with the public SDK facade and protocol-boundary conventions.
entries.zh_cn: 调整仓库布局，使其与公开 SDK facade 和协议边界约定保持一致。
